items.title: 中新社“新闻会客厅”在土耳其迎来首批国际客人
items.summary: 中新网11月12日电 当地时间11月10日，“生态文明与美丽中国实践”主题边会于《联合国气候变化框架公约》第三十一次缔约方大会(COP31)期间在土耳其安塔利亚举办。边会由生态环境部指导，习近平生态文明思想研究中心、中国新闻社主办，生态环境部环境与经济政策研究中心、中国新闻网协办。这是中国新闻社“新闻会客厅”首次在土耳其举办系列活动。
items.titleEn: The first international guests in Turkey were welcomed in the lobby of the news conference
items.summaryEn: China News Network 12 November, Local Time 10 November, the theme of the Ecological Civilization and Practice of Beautiful China Summit was held in Antalya, Turkey, during the Thirty-third Conference of the Parties to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (COP 31). The meeting was led by the Ministry of Ecological Environment, the Xi Jinping Center for Ecological Civilization Thought Research, organized by the China News Agency, the Center for Environmental and Economic Policy Research, and the China News Network. This is the first time that the Chinese news agency Xi Jinping has hosted a series of events in Turkey.

items.title: 明起新一轮冷空气接踵而至 我国大部将迎大风降温
items.summary: 今天（12月14日），全国大部降水仍稀少，雨雪零散分布，冷空气影响也进入尾声阶段。不过，从明天开始，新一轮实力更强的冷空气接踵而至，将率先从新疆北部展开，随后逐渐给我国大部地区带来大风降温天气，同时西南、江汉等地降水也将增多。
items.titleEn: A new round of cold air is expected to bring much of our country to the brink of cooling.
items.summaryEn: Today (December 14), most of the country's rainfall is still scarce, rain and snow are scattered, and the effects of cold air are in the final stages. However, starting tomorrow, a new wave of stronger cold air will be delivered from northern Xinjiang, which will gradually bring cooler weather to much of China, while rainfall will increase in southwest, Jianghan and other areas.
